subject: Renewal procurement: portal onboarding refresh & tiered commit
messages:
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@bluepeakhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Portal <procure@bluepeakhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: vendor onboarding refresh + tiered capacity commit

Hi Stephanie / Vivek,

Hope you’re well. BluePeak’s renewal for our Redwood subscription is up in January. Our procurement team is asking for a vendor-onboarding refresh in the portal (we changed our vendor admin) and a formal path to sign a tiered capacity addendum so we can lock the committed throughput for Q1/Q2. Specific asks from procurement: 

- Updated vendor contact and W-9 / vendor form submitted via your portal
- SOC 2 evidence and data-retention specifics for our compliance team
- Final pricing and PO-ready SOW/addendum reflecting tiered commit (1x, 2x, 3x tiers)
- DocuSign-ready agreement or portal upload instructions

Can we get a quick mutual action plan and expected timelines? Procurement would like the PO ready by Dec 10 to hit their cycle.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Grant
Sr. Procurement Manager, BluePeak Health
alyssa.grant@bluepeakhealth.com
[Attachment: BluePeak_Vendor_Form.pdf (pdf)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@bluepeakhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: vendor onboarding refresh + tiered capacity commit

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear list. We can support the portal refresh and get a tiered-commit SOW ready for PO. Next steps I propose: 

1) I’ll upload the mutual action plan and a draft tiered addendum to the procurement portal today.
2) Vivek will confirm the mapping from your expected throughput to our pricing tiers.
3) Neha will validate the compliance packet (SOC 2 + data-retention) and deliver the final contract redline.
4) We aim to have the DocuSign envelope and a PO-ready SOW by EOD Dec 8 to meet your Dec 10 cycle.

I attached a short mutual action plan that lays out responsibilities and dates. Can you confirm the vendor admin email to use for the portal? Also, is the PO going to be uploaded to the portal or emailed to procure@bluepeakhealth.com?

Attachments: RDW_Mutual_Action_Plan_8321.pdf
Portal link: https://procure.bluepeakhealth.com/vendor/onboarding/rdw-8321
DocuSign (placeholder): https://docusign.net/rdw/envelope/12345678

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 09:02 AM Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@bluepeakhealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Stephanie / Vivek,
> ...

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: BluePeak renewal — artifacts and timing (RDW-8321)

Team, looping you in on the ask from BluePeak (see thread below). Quick items I need from each of you by EOD Dec 4 so we can package into the portal: 

- Neha: confirm the SOC 2 report package we can provide and an approved data-retention statement. Also flag any additional contract language they’ll need (IP, data residency).
- Ben: confirm pricing mapping for the 1x/2x/3x commit tiers and whether we can include a short ramp schedule for usage-based billing.
- Vivek: can you confirm the AM-led approval and whether we should propose a 10% prepayment credit for the annual commit?

I’ll be the point on the mutual action plan and upload. We’re trying to get the PO by Dec 10.

Thanks,
Stephanie

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 14:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: BluePeak renewal — artifacts and timing (RDW-8321)

Stephanie — attached is the capacity/pricing mapping for the three tiers. Notes:

- Tier 1 (baseline): 1.0 committed capacity — price = $X per token/hour; ideal for steady-state.
- Tier 2 (growth): 2.0 committed capacity — price = baseline * 1.8; includes 15% throttled burst buffer.
- Tier 3 (peak): 3.0 committed capacity — price = baseline * 2.6; includes priority routing and extended SLA window.
- We can include a 30-day ramp schedule where they pay baseline for month 1 and move to committed level thereafter.

Attachment: Capacity_Pricing_Tiers.xlsx

Ben

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: BluePeak renewal — artifacts and timing (RDW-8321)

Stephanie — I reviewed the standard addendum and proposed a few redlines to cover data-retention specifics and a narrow audit window for third-party audits. I’m attaching the redline and a compliance checklist (SOC 2 summary + certs). Highlights: 

- Add clause: vendor log retention 90 days (configurable upon request)
- Clarify: Redwood will provide SOC 2 Type II attestation for production fleet; sensitive PII handling scope spelled out in appendix
- Limit audit scope to 3rd-party audit requests with 14-day notice and redaction support

Attachment: RDW_Addendum_Redline.docx

Neha Kapoor
Legal Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@bluepeakhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Procurement Portal <procure@bluepeakhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 15:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: vendor onboarding refresh + tiered capacity commit

Hi Alyssa — following up with the package we discussed. Items uploaded to the procurement portal and attached here for your convenience: 

- RDW_Mutual_Action_Plan_8321.pdf (owners & dates)
- Capacity_Pricing_Tiers.xlsx (pricing by tier)
- RDW_Addendum_Redline.docx (legal redlines)

We prepared a PO-ready SOW + tiered addendum and will generate the DocuSign envelope today once you confirm the vendor admin email. If you’d prefer to upload the PO directly to the portal, use: https://procure.bluepeakhealth.com/vendor/onboarding/rdw-8321 and reference deal RDW-8321.

Can you confirm the portal admin email and whether BluePeak needs the annual/invoice contact on the SOW? Once confirmed I’ll kick off DocuSign and share the link.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

[Attachments: RDW_Mutual_Action_Plan_8321.pdf; Capacity_Pricing_Tiers.xlsx; RDW_Addendum_Redline.docx]

Thanks Stephanie — confirmed. Portal admin to use: vendor-admin@bluepeakhealth.com. Please go ahead and send the DocuSign envelope; BluePeak will sign and upload the PO (BluePeak_PO_9876.pdf) to the portal after the envelope completes.

We reviewed the tier mappings and plan to target Tier 2 with a Q1 ramp to Tier 3 by end of Q2. Procurement will issue the PO this week for portal upload. Our billing contact is finance-payables@bluepeakhealth.com.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this should hit our Dec 10 window.

Best,
Alyssa
